newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Two killed as Nigerian train derails.
newsitem.headline: Two killed as Nigerian train derails.

text.p: Two pasengers died and several were hurt when a commuter train derailed on the outskirts of Lagos at the weekend, local newspapers reported on Monday.
They said the accident happened on Saturday night when the train conveying workers and traders from Lagos terminus overran the tracks a few metres (yards) from a station in the north of the city.
Nigerian railway officials were unavailable to comment on the report.
The newspapers said the train was overcrowded.
